propositions: JiraDataCenterTransport is missing 12 methods the core reconciler calls, causing either AttributeError crashes or silent degradation when writing to DC
The writing reconcile pass crashes on set_entity_property first, but implementing only that method moves the crash deeper—all 12 absent members must be implemented or explicitly rejected
Seven of the twelve absent methods have call sites that swallow all exceptions at every invocation, producing silent operational failures that appear as convergence without actually syncing data
The port TicketTransport is not @runtime_checkable and declares only 6 members while the core actually calls 21 distinct transport methods, leaving the gap detectable only at runtime
DC's identity/reporter handling requires reading the name field into canonical identity via _identity_of, otherwise reporter mutations re-emit infinitely even after successful writes
